title: owner.yml
description: Owner identity configuration for a multiagent-protocol installation. The owner is the human (or trusted accounts) authorized to approve Quadrant D PRs and push break-glass commits.

github_login.description: Primary GitHub login of the owner. This is the default allowlisted actor.

allowlisted_actors.description: GitHub logins whose reactions/comments count as owner approval on Decision Inbox issues and whose direct pushes are valid for break-glass commits. Defaults to [github_login].

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name used in diagnostic comments. NOT used for authentication.
